reviewType: independent AI semantic review of root-authored PCM drafts

scope.grammarRules: not a new rule-translation review; all attached rule contexts were read as evidence

method: Read all310 Korean meanings, every English target, each current PCM translation and all distinct attached Korean rule contexts. Item judgments separately cover actor/referent, gender, quantity, negation, aspect/tense, possession and condition/temporal relations. Hash binding is reported separately from semantic judgment.

items.source: 내일 비가 오면 우리는 집에 있을 거예요.
items.translation: If rain fall tomorrow, we go stay house.

contexts.englishTarget: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
contexts.koreanMeaning: 내일 비가 오면 우리는 집에 있을 거예요.
contexts.rule: if가 이끄는 부분에서는 앞으로의 일도 현재형으로 말해요. it은 3인칭 단수라서 rains예요.

contexts.koreanMeaning: 내일 비가 오면 우리는 집에 있을 거예요.

items.reason: Tomorrow-rain condition leads to plural staying home; negation not introduced.

contexts.englishTarget: If you are hungry, you can eat my sandwich.
contexts.rule: if는 '만약 ~라면'이라는 조건을 나타내요. can 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요.
